plugins.name: Redis Explorer
plugins.description: Browse Redis: connections, databases and keys, grouped by ':' into folders. Strings, hashes, lists, sets, sorted sets and streams open in Quick View; F4 edits a value, F8 deletes keys.
plugins.author: Nuclr Development Team

plugins.name: Redis Value Viewer
plugins.description: Quick View for a Redis key: the text of a string, the fields of a hash, the items of a list, set or sorted set, and the newest entries of a stream.
plugins.author: Nuclr Development Team
